title: God of War Full Story Explained | Kratos From Sparta to Ragnarok
description: The complete story of Kratos explained in order: the Spartan who served Ares, the Ghost of Sparta, the war on Olympus, his new life in the Norse realms with Faye and Atreus, Ragnarok, Valhalla, and what comes next with God of War Laufey.

sections.heading: The story of Kratos
sections.script: Kratos is one of the most famous characters in gaming. He started as a furious Spartan warrior who destroyed the gods of Olympus, and he grew into a quiet father trying to be a better man in the Norse realms. In this video we tell the full God of War story in order, from his life in Sparta, through the Greek games, all the way to Ragnarok and the Valhalla expansion. There will be spoilers for the whole series, so if you have not finished the games yet, this is your warning. Let's begin in ancient Greece.

sections.heading: A deal with Ares
sections.script: Before the games begin, Kratos is a Spartan captain, a brilliant and ruthless commander who never stops chasing victory. One day his army is about to be wiped out by a barbarian horde. Facing death, Kratos calls out to Ares, the God of War, and promises him his life in exchange for victory. Ares accepts. He destroys the barbarians and gives Kratos the Blades of Chaos, two blades chained to his arms and burned into his flesh. From that moment on, Kratos is Ares' servant, and he spreads war and destruction across Greece in his master's name. But Ares wanted more than a soldier. He wanted the perfect warrior, with nothing left to hold him back.

sections.heading: The Ghost of Sparta
sections.script: During an attack on a village, Ares tricks Kratos into killing everyone inside a temple. Among the dead are his own wife, Lysandra, and his daughter, Calliope. Ares had brought them there on purpose, believing that without a family Kratos would become the ultimate weapon. Instead, Kratos is broken. The village oracle curses him so that the ashes of his wife and child stick to his skin forever, turning it pale white. That is why he is known as the Ghost of Sparta. Kratos breaks his bond with Ares, a story told in God of War Ascension, but the nightmares of what he did never leave him. Ascension also shows that breaking an oath to a god comes with terrible punishment, and Kratos pays it.
images: wiki:God of War: Chains of Olympus

sections.heading: Serving the gods
sections.script: Desperate to be free of his nightmares, Kratos spends ten years serving the other gods of Olympus, hoping they will forgive his sins. The prequel games fill in this time. In Chains of Olympus on the PSP, Kratos rescues the sun god Helios and stops Persephone from destroying the world, and he even gives up a chance to be reunited with his daughter in the afterlife to save everything. In Ghost of Sparta, he searches for his lost brother Deimos, who had been taken as a child because of a prophecy. Kratos finds him, but Deimos dies fighting the god of death, Thanatos, and Kratos is left more alone and angrier than ever.

sections.heading: God of War: killing Ares
sections.script: In the first God of War, released in two thousand five, Athena gives Kratos one final task: kill Ares, who is attacking Athens. Only one weapon can kill a god, Pandora's Box, hidden in a temple on the back of the Titan Cronos. Kratos fights his way through the temple, takes the box and uses its power to grow to a god's size and defeat Ares. The gods forgive his sins, but they cannot erase his nightmares. Kratos climbs to a cliff and throws himself into the sea, but Athena saves him, and he is given Ares' empty throne on Olympus. The Spartan who served the God of War has become the new God of War.

sections.heading: God of War Two and Three: the fall of Olympus
sections.script: As God of War, Kratos keeps leading Sparta's armies across Greece, and the other gods grow nervous. In God of War Two, Zeus tricks him, drains his power and kills him. Kratos climbs out of the Underworld with the help of the Titan Gaia and travels to the Sisters of Fate to change his destiny. He learns that Zeus is his father, and he leads the Titans in a war on Olympus. God of War Three, released in twenty ten, is that war. Kratos kills Poseidon, Hades, Helios, Hermes, Hercules and Hera, and finally Zeus himself. Greece falls into chaos. In the end Kratos releases the power of hope to the world and stabs himself with the Blade of Olympus. It looked like the end of his story.

sections.heading: A new life in the north
sections.script: But Kratos survived. Years later, in God of War twenty eighteen, he lives in Midgard, one of the Norse realms, far from Greece. He has a new wife, Faye, and a young son, Atreus. The game begins with Faye's death. Her last wish is for her ashes to be scattered from the highest peak in all the realms. Kratos and Atreus set out together, but Kratos is a cold and distant father who hides his past and his godhood from his son. They are hunted by a mysterious stranger, who turns out to be Baldur, a son of Odin who cannot feel anything. Along the way they meet Mimir, a wise head who joins them, and the dwarf brothers Brok and Sindri.

sections.heading: The truth about Faye and Atreus
sections.script: As the journey goes on, Kratos teaches Atreus to control his anger, and Atreus learns that his father is a god, which makes him one too. Kratos is forced to pick up the Blades of Chaos again, facing the past he tried to bury. They kill Baldur to protect Freya, Baldur's own mother, who never forgives them. Finally they reach Jotunheim, the land of the giants, and discover the truth. Faye was a giant, and she planned the whole journey herself. Atreus' giant name, the name his mother gave him, is Loki. And a mural shows something even more shocking: a vision of Kratos dying in the arms of his son. With that prophecy hanging over them, Fimbulwinter begins, the long winter that comes before Ragnarok.

sections.heading: Ragnarok
sections.script: God of War Ragnarok, released in twenty twenty two, picks up during Fimbulwinter. Thor and Odin arrive at their door, and Odin offers peace if they stop searching for Tyr, the missing Norse god of war. Atreus refuses to give up, and later he secretly goes to Asgard, where he helps Odin search for a mysterious mask while trying to learn about his own destiny as Loki, while Kratos struggles to let his son grow up. Tragedy strikes when Brok is killed by Odin. Kratos realises that prophecy is not fate, and he chooses to fight Odin together with the giants, the dwarves and his new allies. In the final battle Asgard is destroyed, Odin is defeated, and Kratos does not die. Another mural reveals the true prophecy: Kratos as a loved and respected leader. Atreus leaves to find the last giants on his own, and father and son say goodbye as equals.

sections.heading: Valhalla and a new God of War
sections.script: In December twenty twenty three, the free Valhalla expansion added an epilogue. Kratos enters Valhalla and is forced to confront his Greek past, including his time as the God of War. Instead of running from it, he finally accepts it and decides to become a different kind of God of War: a god who protects instead of destroying. Then in February twenty twenty six, Sons of Sparta, a new 2D game, went back to Kratos' youth in Sparta. And Sony has also announced a remake of the original Greek trilogy, so Kratos' early story will get a fresh look too.
images: wiki:God of War Sons of Sparta

sections.heading: What comes next
sections.script: The next chapter is God of War Laufey, coming on February sixteenth, twenty twenty seven for PlayStation 5. For the first time in a main game, you play as Faye instead of Kratos. Her story runs at the same time as God of War twenty eighteen and Ragnarok, after her death, in a realm called the Everywhen, where gods go when they die. Kratos returns as a non-playable character, and Faye fights to protect the plans she left for her husband and son. So the story of Kratos is not finished yet. Which era do you prefer, the angry Ghost of Sparta or the father of the Norse games? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe to HarryBeast Gaming for more God of War videos.
